The '''ion relic pistol''' was a rare [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] which used [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion particles]] to puncture the target, causing severe damage. It could be constructed using the [[Chu-Gon Dar cube]]. A slight variant was the '''Oppressor pistol''' in possession of the [[GK Oppressor]].<ref name="TOW" />
